The proposed solution correctly identifies the classic stepsize condition for Popov’s (optimistic) method applied to pseudo‑monotone variational inequalities with an \(L\)-Lipschitz operator. Standard convergence analyses show that the method is guaranteed to converge when the stepsize \(\lambda\) satisfies \(\lambda < 1/(2L)\), and this bound cannot be improved in general because counter‑examples exist for larger stepsizes. Hence the final answer \(\lambda < 1/(2L)\) is accurate.
